svg.title: When the end-to-end tests run
svg.desc: A pull request runs the end-to-end tests only when it changes the app, its tests or their workflow; otherwise both required checks pass at once. The check nextcloud then runs the oldest and the newest supported version, and the check nextcloud on PostgreSQL, MariaDB and S3 the versions between, the newest version on those databases and S3 when the change can behave differently there, and the upgrade from the last release when the change can break it. Every push to main and every night run both, and every Monday the canary runs the tests against the coming Nextcloud. The contract tests run the app against a real Paperless-ngx 2.x and 3.x every Monday, by hand, and in a pull request that changes how the app talks to Paperless.
